# Template:Pipe

<div class="mw-parser-output">

This is the **&#123;&#123;pipe&#125;&#125;** meta-template. It looks like this: \|

This template uses the **\&#124;** decimal code for the vertical bar (or pipe character) so that its usage doesn't cause problems when it is used inside a template e.g. for lua API documentation which uses a modified form of <a href="http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Backusâ€“Naur_Form" class="external text" rel="nofollow">BNF</a>. **&#123;&#123;pipe&#125;&#125;** is easier to remember and clearer than an unadorned **\&#124;**.

Please do not use the Unicode **\&#448;** (which produces ǀ) since that does not work in all web browsers. It is also slightly smaller than \|.

</div>
